hero.headline: Your Bargara holiday apartment.
hero.headlineAccent: Koola Palms 101, moments from the beach.
hero.lead: Discover a fully renovated two-bedroom ground-floor holiday apartment in Bargara, with a designer kitchen, private patio overlooking parkland, pool and spa access, and the beach a short stroll away. Choose the room name for your booking channel and confirm Apartment 101 before payment.
